text.tspan: GATEWAY / HTTPROUTE FORWARDS THE REQUEST TO THE MODEL'S INFERENCEPOOL.
LLM-D ROUTER EPP DECIDES WHETHER PREFILL IS NEEDED AND PICKS THE ROLE-SPECIFIC BACKENDS.
DECODE REMAINS THE COORDINATION POINT, SO THE CLIENT STILL SEES ONE ENDPOINT.
KV TRANSFER BRIDGES PREFILL AND DECODE.
RESPONSE STREAMING STILL RETURNS THROUGH THE DECODE PATH.
